Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you
reported. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you the facts of what happened, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Let's start with where you were when the collision occurred.
A: I was in Pearland, Texas, on a city street, heading toward a shopping center. I was in the left-turn lane at a
signalized intersection.
Q: What was the signal showing when you entered the intersection?
A: It had turned from yellow to green, and I was waiting for oncoming traffic to clear so I could complete the turn.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle coming from the opposite direction hit my car's front driver's side while I was partway through the turn. I
felt a hard jolt, and my airbag deployed.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?
A: Not clearly. I noticed headlights, but I didn't judge its speed well. I thought it was far enuogh away.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My left wrist hit the steering wheel and the steering wheel area. I was taken by ambluance to a hospital, and I
was told I had a fracture in my wrist. I'm now in a cast and have been seeing a specialist.
Q: Has a doctor given you an estimate for how long you'll be off work or limited in use of your hand?
A: Not yet. The follow-up appointment is next week, and I'll know more then.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your account?
A: Only that I was following the signal and I'm still shaken up by it. I'm willing to provide any records you need.
Q: Understood. That concludes the statement. Thank you.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
